title: Empty state with a next action
when: The user wants what a list, search or dashboard shows when there is nothing in it yet or no result matched.
inputs: which empty case (first use, no results, all done)
prompt:
Goal: A short, helpful message in place of the missing content that explains why it is empty and offers one next step.
Steps:
1. Choose the case: first use (explain value, primary action), no results (echo the query, offer Clear filters), all done (a short confirmation).
2. Content: a small optional SVG with aria-hidden="true", an h2 of a few words, one sentence and one primary button or link.
3. Render it inside the same container the list uses, so the layout stays put.
4. For searches, put the message in a role="status" region so No results for shoes is announced.
5. The echoed query is user input: insert it with textContent only.
Quality bar:
- Copy is friendly and specific to the screen.
- The action solves the empty case directly.
- The illustration stays small.
Pitfalls:
- A blank area with no message.
- Blaming the user (You did not add anything).
- Inserting the search text with innerHTML.
Verify:
- [ ] Each empty case has a heading and an action.
- [ ] Decorative SVG is aria-hidden.
- [ ] No results are announced.
- [ ] Query text uses textContent.
Output: Empty state markup or a render function, plus its rules in style.css.

examples.input: tela vazia quando nao tem pedidos ainda
examples.output: h2 "No orders yet", one line on how orders appear, Create your first product button; search case echoes the query
